notes: Recall is detected buggy targets divided by all 265 assigned cases; missing runs remain in the denominator.
Eight direct reviewer configurations and two agent harness configurations are shown separately by kind.
Companion target-presence judgments test whether the benchmark target is still present. Zero target hits are not a measured zero false-positive rate.
Historical results and task payloads are copied from the final 265-case snapshot; this export makes no new model calls.

Red ground-truth marks require a complete snippet match, revision-validated coordinates, or substantial unique excerpt anchors with quoted literals preserved. Only proven matching excerpt lines are marked; omissions and unmatched text remain documented.
Companion source shows the upstream fixing revision. The original composed companion diff is preserved separately; it is not necessarily the native fixing-commit diff.
Unavailable scanner cost is null rather than zero.
